svg.title: Residential gap scenarios
svg.desc: NESTED SCENARIOS · NOT IDENTIFIED CASES 2024 Census − 2026H1 SII records. Observed settlement households are deducted assuming one household per dwelling. The residual uses the Census commune share with acceptable type and materials; ≈ figures are rounded. Identifies neither unregistered homes nor tax debt. 222 CNC polygons lack counts; deduction is incomplete.
